title: The Eagle Standard of Ionith
summary: At the Black Lacquer Pagoda and the Temple of the Serpent Emperor, tally-seal custodians and expedition scouts untangle a Tsaesci blood-lineage intrigue surrounding the lost Tenth Legion Eagle Standard.

hook.rumour: A lacquer tally-chest washed up near the Black Lacquer Pagoda bearing the bronze numerals of Uriel V's lost Tenth Legion, sparking a covert race toward the Temple of the Serpent Emperor.
hook.notice: BLACK LACQUER PAGODA COMPOUND: Blades and translators sought to trace the Tenth Legion tally-seals across Tsaesci.

npcs.name: Warden of Black Lacquer Pagoda
npcs.greet: A lacquer tally-chest washed up near the Black Lacquer Pagoda bearing the bronze numerals of Uriel V's lost Tenth Legion, sparking a covert race toward the Temple of the Serpent Emperor.
talk: The trouble across Tsaesci began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Black Lacquer Pagoda.
If you mean to help the Viper Port Custodians, start by checking the trail between Black Lacquer Pagoda and Tsaesci Coil Shrine.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Black Lacquer Pagoda
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Tsaesci Coil Shrine is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Tsaesci Coil Shrine toward Temple of the Serpent Emperor before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Black Lacquer Pagoda so Seal-Custodian Kessan can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Temple of the Serpent Emperor
npcs.greet: You made good time from Tsaesci Coil Shrine. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Serpent Jungle Camp.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Serpent Jungle Camp with a picked guard.
Once Serpent Jungle Camp is cleared, return to Black Lacquer Pagoda to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Black Lacquer Pagoda
npcs.greet: Seal-Custodian Kessan awaits word on whether the crisis in Tsaesci has been contained.
talk: The elders of Black Lacquer Pagoda have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Tsaesci owes you a debt for standing between Black Lacquer Pagoda and ruin.
